title: Baby Bunny Bellies Tradescantia - 1x Mini Plug Plants- Tradescantia Chrysophylla
description:
Soft, Fuzzy, and Fabulous: Bring the "Baby Bunny Bellies" Charm to Your Home!


KEY FEATURES
• Irresistibly soft, fuzzy leaves with green tops and purple-red undersides
• Beautiful trailing growth habit, perfect for hanging baskets and terrariums
• Low-maintenance and easy to care for, suitable for all skill levels
• Compact size, ideal for small spaces and desk decor
• Evergreen foliage provides year-round visual appeal and air-purifying qualities


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Tradescantia chrysophylla 'Baby Bunny Bellies'
Colour: Green and purple foliage; small white or lavender flowers (rarely indoors)
Season: Year-round foliage; late spring/early summer for flowers
Growth Habit: Trailing


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Bright, indirect light to partial shade
Soil: Well-draining potting soil or houseplant mix
Watering: Keep soil consistently moist but not soggy; allow top inch to dry between waterings
Spacing: Allow 12-24 inches for spread in containers or hanging baskets
Height: 4-12 inches (with trailing vines up to 18 inches)
Spread: 12-24 inches
Hardiness: H1B (UK), USDA Zone 9b-11


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Provide bright, indirect light; avoid direct sun which can scorch leaves.
• Water when the top inch of soil feels dry, ensuring good drainage to prevent root rot.
• Maintain typical indoor temperatures (18-24°C) and moderate to high humidity; mist occasionally.
• Feed with a balanced houseplant fertiliser every 4-6 weeks during spring and summer.
• Prune trailing stems to encourage bushier growth and maintain desired shape.
